subject: Azure marketplace — annual prepay SKU bundling & term structure
messages:
From: Sara Hsu <sara@lumendata.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Azure private offer: annual prepay and SKU bundling questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're evaluating Redwood to replace our inference endpoint for a subset of Horizon workloads and are interested in an Azure marketplace private offer with an annual prepay. A few items we need clarity on before procurement can move fast: 

- Can you support a SKU-bundled private offer (compute + inference units) with one invoice?
- LumenData's finance prefers annual prepay (rather than monthly) with a 12-month co-term. Do you have a standard term-discount schedule for 1yr vs 3yr?
- We expect ramp: year1 = 300k tokens/month average, year2 = 900k, year3 = 1.8M. We prefer smoothing credits across the year rather than monthly reconciliations — is that supported?
- Any marketplace fees or platform surcharges we should budget for? (we're on Azure EU region)

If helpful, procurement can share target ARR and preferred payment cadence. Can you loop in marketplace & finance folks? Hoping to close by end of May.

Best,
Sara
Procurement, LumenData

--
LumenData Corp
procurement@lumendata.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Hsu <sara@lumendata.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private offer: annual prepay and SKU bundling questions

Hi Sara — really appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front, and I'll follow with details after I sync with finance/marketplace: 

- Yes, we can bundle compute + inference SKUs into a single private offer line items set on Azure Marketplace with one invoice via our finance integration.
- Term discounts: typical policy is 0% for 1yr prepaid baseline, 12% for 2yr, 18% for 3yr on list unit prices; however, for larger commits we can reprice (examples below).
- Ramp smoothing: we support annualized credits for prepay (you draw down credits from the committed pool). We can also do agreed monthly allocations to match expected usage with reconciliation at renewal.
- Marketplace fees: Azure takes its standard marketplace fee (varies by offer type) — we typically build that into the private offer gross margin, but we will surface the fee and the net unit pricing.

I'll loop in Vanessa from Marketplace and Diego from Sales Ops to prepare a proposed XLS with a couple of term/discount scenarios (1yr annual prepay, 3yr stepped ramp with front-loaded credits, and a smoothing option). Can we set a 30-min call tomorrow?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Hsu <sara@lumendata.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private offer: annual prepay and SKU bundling questions

Thanks Karthik — tomorrow 10:00am CET works for our team (I'm in Amsterdam). I'll include Tom Alvarez from Azure Marketplace and our legal lead on the call. For context, target first-year committed spend is EUR 150k (annual prepay), ramping to ~EUR 420k in year2 and ~EUR 780k year3 if performance holds. Our preferred outcome is a 1yr annual prepay with an option to extend to 3yr if we hit ramp triggers.

Sara
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T02:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Azure private offer: annual prepay and SKU bundling questions (LumenData) — prep for tomorrow

Team — prepping materials for the call with LumenData (tomorrow 10:00 CET). Key asks below and proposed approach. Please reply with comments before I jump on.

Customer asks:
- Single invoice SKU bundle (compute + inference) on Azure private offer
- Annual prepay preferred; they may accept 1yr now and extend to 3yr with triggers
- Ramp smoothing (annual credits drawdown)
- Visibility into marketplace fee impact on net price

Our proposed approach:
1) Create a single private-offer line item that represents the "LumenData Annual Commitment" with internal mapping to multiple SKUs for redemption (compute throughput hours + token units). That keeps the invoice simple.
2) Pricing scenarios to present: 
   a) 1yr annual prepay: price = list - 7% (intro offer) with annualized credits and rolling monthly consumption reporting.
   b) 3yr commit: year1 discount 12%, year2 15%, year3 18% (tiered step-up) with option to re-evaluate if usage >150% of forecast.
   c) 1yr convertible: 1yr prepay at 9% discount with an exercise window to convert to a 3yr commit at day 270 with a retroactive credit for year1 difference.
3) Absorb Azure marketplace fee into our listed price and show both gross and net unit economics (line showing Azure fee ~3-5% depending on offer type).
4) Give an option for annualized credit smoothing vs strict monthly reconciliation. For smoothing, credits applied monthly based on forecast; final reconciliation at renewal.

Open questions: approvals needed from finance for a convertible 1yr -> 3yr policy and legal for conversion mechanics. Diego/Laura: can you confirm margin floor and whether we can offer the convertible structure? Also attaching a mock XLS for numbers (I'll iterate).

Attachments: RDW_LumenData_Azure_PrivateOffer_v1.xlsx (draft scenarios)

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Azure private offer: annual prepay and SKU bundling questions (LumenData) — prep for tomorrow

Quick internal reply — finance ok with the 1yr intro 7% and 3yr step-up 12/15/18 as long as we: 
- Keep margin floor at 23% net after marketplace fees and expected Azure Marketplace commission.
- Require a minimum EUR 100k first-year ARR to qualify for the convertible clause.
- For the convertible option, legal needs a clear cut-off and an automated credit adjustment (no manual reconciliations).

Vanessa: marketplace ops will need to confirm whether a single invoice mapping to multiple redemption SKUs is supported for this private-offer type (I believe yes). If not, we fall back to two line items (compute / inference).

I'll be on the call and can present the finance guardrails.

-Diego
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Hsu <sara@lumendata.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@azuremarketplace.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed annual prepay private offer & next steps — LumenData

Hi Sara / team — great call earlier. Per our discussion, attached is the proposed private-offer package and a short explainer. Highlights: 

- Offer structure: Annual prepay (12 months) representing a bundled line item (compute + inference credits). Single invoice via Azure private offers.
- Pricing scenarios attached: (Sheet 1: 1yr annual prepay — 7% intro discount; Sheet 2: 1yr convertible to 3yr — 9% with conversion mechanics; Sheet 3: 3yr step-up commit 12/15/18).
- Ramp smoothing: we will apply annualized credits with monthly allocations based on agreed forecast and do a reconciliation at renewal. If usage exceeds forecast by >150% in any rolling 90-day window, additional consumption will be billed at on-demand unit rates.
- Marketplace fees: shown explicitly on sheet — assumed 4% for this offer; gross -> net bridges included.
- Conditions: minimum first-year commit EUR 100k; convertible option requires signed amendment by day 270 and is only available if payments are made on schedule.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm preferred pricing scenario and whether you want the convertible path.
2) If confirmed, we'll generate the Azure private-offer link and share a NOPA stub for signature.
3) Legal to exchange redlines (we flagged conversion mechanics and termination for convenience).

Attachments included: RDW_LumenData_Azure_PrivateOffer_v1.xlsx, Azure_PrivateOffer_Link.txt, NOPA_signed_stub.pdf

Happy to hop back on if you want to walk through the XLS.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Hsu <sara@lumendata.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumendata.com, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@azuremarketplace.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T18:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed annual prepay private offer & next steps — LumenData

Karthik — thanks for the crisp summary and attachments. We're leaning to the 1yr convertible to 3yr (Sheet 2) provided: 
- The convertible mechanics are automatic with a credit adjustment (no manual invoices).
- Minimum first-year paid EUR 100k is acceptable.
- Legal will redline the amendment for the conversion window and termination/clawback language.

I'll get procurement and legal engaged today; expect initial redlines by May 21. If everything aligns, we'll accept the private-offer link and wire the prepay. Appreciate the team's quick turnaround.

Regards,
Sara
Procurement — LumenData
